MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_CANDY.title: Cursed Candy
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_CANDY.descripti: Every [red]5[/red] normal combats, your card rewards are replaced with unskippable [purple]Curses[/purple].
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_CANDY.flavor: Sweet on the tongue, bitter in the soul.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_ROD.title: Cursed Rod
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_ROD.description: Every [red]5[/red] normal combats, [red]Downgrade[/red] a random card in your Deck.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_ROD.flavor: A crooked tool that corrodes all it touches.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_SEAL.title: Cursed Seal
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_SEAL.descriptio: Cards in your starting deck are [gold]Eternal[/gold].
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_SEAL.flavor: What has been bound cannot be cast aside.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_HUMIDIFIER.desc: Whenever you Rest at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], lose [red]5[/red] Max HP.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_HUMIDIFIER.flav: The mist clings to more than skin.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_MASK.title: Cursed Mask
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_MASK.descriptio: At the start of combat, put a random [blue]Power[/blue] from your Draw Pile into your Hand. It costs [red]2[/red] additional [blue]Energy[/blue] this turn.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-CURSED_MASK.flavor: Its gems shine brightest when fed.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-EMPTY_LARGE_CAPSULE.de: Upon pickup, add an additional [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] to your Deck.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-EMPTY_LARGE_CAPSULE.fl: The contents are gone. The weight remains.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-INERT_ECTOPLASM.title: Inert Ectoplasm
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-INERT_ECTOPLASM.flavor: It sticks to every coin you reach for.
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-SMALL_HOLSTER.title: Small Holster
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-STONE_PILLOW.title: Stone Pillow
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-STONE_PILLOW.descripti: Whenever you Rest, healing is reduced by [red]50%[/red].
MODIFIERSEXPANDED-STONE_PILLOW.flavor: A poor place to lay a weary head.
